transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?
I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for about a year and two months now. I decided to come in today because it's not getting any better and I really need some help.
Have you had any period of at least two months during this time when you felt back to your usual self?
No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. It has been continuous for the entire year and two months, without a single period where I felt back to my usual self.
During this time, have you also had symptoms like changes in sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of hopelessness?
No, I haven't really noticed any changes in my sleep, appetite, or energy levels. My concentration seems okay too, and I wouldn't say I've been feeling hopeless.
Have you also lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't really noticed a change in my interest or pleasure in things.
Has this low mood been causing problems in your work, school, or relationships?
I'm not really sure about that. I haven't thought much about how it has affected my work or relationships, so I can't say for sure.
Have you had any changes in your sleep, appetite, energy, concentration, or feelings of hopelessness?
Like I mentioned, I haven't really noticed any changes in those areas. My sleep, appetite, and concentration seem to be about the same, and I don't feel hopeless.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt much more depressed than usual, or had thoughts of death or suicide?
Yes, I have been feeling persistently depressed and sad for the entire year and two months, which is much longer than just two weeks. However, I have never had any thoughts of death or suicide.

Have there been at least two weeks during this time when your depression was clearly worse than usual and you had several symptoms at once, like low mood, loss of interest, sleep or appetite changes, low energy, poor concentration, or feelings of worthlessness?

I'm not really sure, as I haven't noticed a specific two-week period where things suddenly got much worse with all of those symptoms. I have just felt generally down and worthless for a long time now.
Have you felt low or depressed most of the day, more days than not, for most of the past two years?

I have definitely felt constantly low and depressed almost every day, but not for two whole years. It has been going on like this for about a year and two months now. It just feels like a continuous, heavy sadness that won't lift.
Have you ever had a period of at least two weeks when you felt much more depressed than usual, or had thoughts of death or suicide?
Yes, I have been feeling persistently depressed and sad for about a year and two months now, which is much longer than just two weeks. However, I have never had any thoughts of death or suicide.
